text: According to Global Workspace Theory, phenomenal consciousness is identical to the quantity of integrated information (Φ) in a system.
explanation: That identity claim belongs to Integrated Information Theory, not Global Workspace Theory. GWT holds that a state is conscious when its information is globally broadcast to many consuming subsystems — an access-based account — while Φ is Tononi's measure in IIT. The statement misattributes IIT's central thesis to GWT, so it is false.
